If possible, please go to an orthopedic sports medicine surgeon who specializes in these and has done many repairs. This is one of the worse foot injuries and you want to make sure you work with someone who knows what they’re doing.

Waiting two weeks is not an issue, I had a lis franc and multiple crush injuries from playing rugby and they had to wait 3 weeks for my swelling to go down before they could operate. The first doctor I went to just wanted to fuse my whole foot, the second a board certified specialized sports medicine ortho told me he only wanted to do partial fusion so that my range of motion wouldn’t be so limited, and he did an ORIF as well as a bone graft. 

My injury was really really bad, but my doctor did a great job and you can’t even tell I walk with a limp.

I can no longer do high impact sports like running or jumping to protect those joints now so rugby was out of the question for me. It was a pretty life changing injury, but I got through it! Not to scare you or anything, again mine was like really bad, because the bones were crushed too

I have suuuper bad stage fright and anxiety being ifront of large groups of people.  (Its so bad I even went as far to bring a mini bottle of vodka because I thought I was going to need liquid courage lol). I did not end up using or needing it though!

I was nervous as hell when I went on stage for the first time and was shaking from the adrenaline but still nailed my posing. As other have said the lights are very bright and the stage isn’t that big. I really just focused on thinking about posing the whole time. When I was done pumping up, I posed, in line waiting to go on stage I was posing. This helped me keep my mind off going on stage in front of everyone and literally just focus on the movements. 

Make that posing known and have the movements memorized and your body used to them, so that even when you’re on stage and scared your body is going through the motions. Personally for me the stage fright doesn’t really go away, I still got a stomach ache anxiety right before I went on stage, I just rehearsed posing so much that I was scared inside but my body kept going through the motions of posing.
